historical_record.description: On its naming committee's recommendation, after letters from a citizens committee and the Western Addition District Council, the Recreation and Park Commission named the Hamilton Annex Recreation Area the Raymond S. Kimbell Playground, for the department's former general manager, who had served it for thirty-five years.
The Recreation and Park Commission ratified a $158,820 contract with Munkdale Bros. Inc. for work at Raymond S. Kimbell Playground.
